description: This file contains test cases for functions related to spawn context metadata and workspace resolution in a testing framework (Vitest). It defines multiple test suites verifying behavior of functions such as normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata, mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata, resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance, and resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun.

methods.name: normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Normalizes spawn metadata object by trimming whitespace and removing empty fields.

methods.name: mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Maps tool context fields to spawn metadata shape.

methods.name: resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory for a spawned process based on config, explicit override, or target agent.

methods.name: resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun
methods.description: Determines the ingress workspace override for a spawned run based on the spawn metadata.
